description: Runs a handler or an endpoint on the platform using local files, without publishing them (tgcloud run). args is the payload (a Message for handlers/message, or the endpoint input) as a JSON5 object. ctx is the second argument (--ctx): the raw update for a handler, or initData for an endpoint, for example { initData: { user: { id: 1, first_name: "Ann" } } }. Returns the value, captured console logs, and elapsed time.

args.description: Handler payload or endpoint input as JSON5, for example '{ chat: { id: 1 }, text: "hi" }'

module.description: Module path, for example handlers/message or endpoints/getProfile

project_dir.description: Absolute path to a tgcloud project directory (contains .tgcloud/)

name: run_handler
title: Run a module without deploying
